newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's Aussie Homes Loans says lending soars.
newsitem.headline: Australia's Aussie Homes Loans says lending soars.

text.p: Australia's non-bank lender, Aussie Home Loans, said on Thursday new loans written jumped 45 percent to A$3.26 billion for the year to June 30, 1997.
Aussie Home Loans managing director John Symond said the company, a mortgage originator established in 1992, is now the country's fifth largest home lender, employing 650 staff.
Symond said in a statement the company was pleased with the quality of its lending programme, with its rate of overdue mortgage payments under half the national average.
Aussie Home Loans' arrears after 30 days stood at just 0.53 percent, he said.
